title: Fake Benefits Enrollment
scenario: A benefits email asks employees to enter personal data on a new domain.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.C: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.
answers.D: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.

explanation: Fake Benefits Enrollment: the trap is to make borrowed authority feel safer than checking. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Benefits enrollment should use verified HR portals.
